title: docs(skills): pages.md says what a page type, template and region name run
body:
Fixes #23610
Clause-②: no

Executes ruling `6190536588` item 4 under claim `6204703954`: `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md` says what PR #23708 makes the page contract. This PR is the card's last piece and carries its closing keyword (#23708 is `Part of #23610`). **It turns ready only after #23708 has merged** — the seat marks it; the dev does not — and, as a `skills/**` diff (governed, Tier H), it lands only after a human approval, by the seat.

## What changes

One skill file, `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md`, plus a `@objectstack/skills` patch changeset. Every sentence follows the spec text #23708 lands — `PageTypeSchema`'s docblock and enum comments, `PageTemplateSchema`, `PAGE_TEMPLATE_SLOTS`, `checkPageRegionPlacement`, `misplacedDefaultPageRefusal`, the `utility` print refusal — and `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx`'s new wording. Nothing the spec does not declare enters the skill.

| Where (line on `main`) | Was | Now |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Page Types table, `home` (24) | App home / landing page | Widest region page; not a landing (`isDefault` refused): an app opens on its first navigation item |
| Page Types table, `app` (25) | App-level page with navigation context | Region page at app width |
| Page Types table, `utility` (26) | Floating utility panel (e.g. notes, phone dialer) | Narrow inline region page for a tool (notes, a dialer); no floating or docked shell slot exists |
| Disambiguation paragraph (29–34) | "…a utility panel is `type: 'utility'`…" plus a restatement of the table's three `type` values | The no-such-type list and the visualizations-are-not-page-types sentence stay; the restated `type` values go (the table carries them) |
| Templates & Regions (38–41) | `three-column` / `two-column` / `single-column`; regions `header`, `left_sidebar`, `main`, `right_sidebar`, `footer` | `default` (header, sidebar, main, aside, footer), `header-sidebar-main` (header, sidebar, main), `three-column` (the same five), `dashboard` (header, footer; other regions are grid cells); `full-width` retired; on a `kind: 'full'` page a region the template does not place, or a second region for a filled slot, is refused at its `name`; left column `sidebar`, right `aside` |
| Print pages (71–72) | "a `utility` panel" | "a `utility` page" |
| Source tiers (137–138) | "The legacy value `kind:'jsx'` is a deprecated alias for `kind:'html'`" | "`kind:'jsx'` is retired: the parse refuses it and names `kind:'html'`" (#23543 F5-jsx, PR #23638) |

The `home` row's landing sentence is the one `misplacedDefaultPageRefusal` prints (an app's landing is its first navigation item); the `utility` row's is `PageTypeSchema`'s ("no floating or docked shell slot"); the template sentence is `PAGE_TEMPLATE_SLOTS` plus `checkPageRegionPlacement`'s two refusals (unplaced region; second region for a filled slot). The file mentioned no page default or landing anywhere else, so nothing else moved.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么** 只改一个对外发布的技能文件 `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md`(加一条 `@objectstack/skills` patch changeset)。页面类型表里 `home` 不再写成「应用落地页」,改为「最宽的区域页;不是落地声明(`isDefault` 被拒),应用打开的是第一个导航项」;`utility` 不再写成「浮动工具面板」,改为「窄的内联区域页,没有浮动或停靠的外壳槽位」;「模板与区域」一段从 `three-column / two-column / single-column` 与 `left_sidebar / right_sidebar` 改为 #23708 落地的封闭模板集(`default`、`header-sidebar-main`、`three-column`、`dashboard`)和各自放置的区域名(左栏 `sidebar`、右栏 `aside`;`full-width` 退役;模板不放置的区域、重复占槽的区域被拒);`kind:'jsx'` 从「`html` 的别名」改为「已退役,解析时被拒并指向 `html`」。

**为什么改** 这份技能是 AI 写页面元数据时读的规则。它教的 `two-column`、`left_sidebar`、「home 是落地页」在 #23708 之后会被 `os validate` 和保存门直接拒收(在此之前则是静默错排或无效声明),也就是技能本身在教 AI 写出会被拒的元数据。裁决 `6190536588` 第 4 项把这份文件的更新单列为一个 Tier H PR。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** 零运行时影响:只有技能文本与 changeset,不碰 `packages/**`。文本描述的是 #23708 合入之后的契约,所以本 PR 在 #23708 合入前保持 draft,不会先于契约发布。token 棘轮零余量,新增内容靠删同文件的三处重复/指针付账(净 −14 字节),没有抬上限。回滚 = revert 这一个 commit 对,无状态可清理。

**席位意见** 同意合入。#23708 已于 10-16 02:31Z 落地(`a69a40a572`),`main` 上的 spec 现在就拒收这份技能旧的教法(`two-column`、`left_sidebar`、home 上的 `isDefault`);不合入,技能就在教 AI 写一定会被拒的页面元数据。改动只有一份技能文本加一条 patch changeset,零运行时影响,不碰契约(`Clause-②: no`),CI 全绿,与 `main` 无冲突。为满足 token 上限删掉的三处都是重复说明或源码指针,没有删任何规则;其中删 `responsive.zod.ts` 源码指针一处,席位已确认可接受。

**你要做的** 一个动作:在本 PR 上点 Approve。席位随后开 auto-merge 落地,#23610 随之关闭。
